## Gemini 4 Argon API

Gemini 4 Argon is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-4-argon`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Gemini 4 Argon is Google's frontier model for complex workflows across software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity defense, with a unified 1M token context window and tunable thinking.

### Gemini 4 Argon API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-4-argon` | Standard | Anonymized | $2.50 / $12.50 per 1M |

### Gemini 4 Argon specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Oct 13, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Gemini 4 Argon API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "gemini-4-argon"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-argon",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
